decision.observation: 2:20 pm; the C press reeled the line back in again—the pink curl above the bobber was a nibble, not the bite. The farmer stands at the pond's north rim with the bamboo pole selected.
decision.hypothesis: The genuine bite ('HIT!' text over the water) will come after several nibbles; pressing C exactly at 'HIT!' opens the catch minigame, which I've won once.
decision.memory: Fishing loop: face water, hold C to cast, ignore nibble sprites, press C at 'HIT!', then hold/release LMB to keep the green bar on the fish. Sunfish caught day 5.
